subject: Pendidikan Moral
edition: Terbitan 2018, Bahagian Pembangunan Kurikulum KPM, September 2018 (KSSM Pendidikan Moral Tingkatan 4 dan 5)
structureNote: Hierarchy: Bidang (theme; the whole KSSM Moral has 7 bidang, Bidang 1-4 are Tingkatan 1-3, this DSKP covers Bidang 5 Insan Bermoral, 6 Jati Diri Moral, 7 Moral dan Kenegaraan for BOTH T4 and T5 with different topics per form) > Standard Kandungan (x.y, a topic) > 6 Standard Pembelajaran (x.y.1-x.y.6). In this file one unit = one SK (topic) because each SK carries its own Standard Prestasi table of Tahap Penguasaan 1-6; the unit therefore has exactly one entry in standards. Every SK has the same 6-SP pattern (x.y.1-x.y.4 cognitive: define/list -> explain -> evaluate/predict -> analyse; x.y.5 express feeling (afektif); x.y.6 practise in daily life (perlakuan)). Minimum 64 hours over T4+T5 (min hours per year). Catatan column (Cadangan nilai / isu / aktiviti) deliberately not extracted. Printed typos kept as printed (e.g. "Berbeza" capitalised in SP 7.2.5 T4). Bidang headings use the printed numbering 5.0/6.0/7.0 in both forms, so the same SK code (e.g. 5.1) exists in T4 and T5 with different titles - always key by (level, code).
